The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8091` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.MgmtPort`)
- Port: `18091` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.MgmtSslPort`)
- Port: `8092` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.ViewPort`)
- Port: `18092` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.ViewSslPort`)
- Port: `8093` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.QueryPort`)
- Port: `18093` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.QuerySslPort`)
- Port: `8094` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.SearchPort`)
- Port: `18094` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.SearchSslPort`)
- Port: `8095` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.AnalyticsPort`)
- Port: `18095` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.AnalyticsSslPort`)
- Port: `8096` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.EventingPort`)
- Port: `18096` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.EventingSslPort`)
- Port: `11210` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.KvPort`)
- Port: `11207` (see `CouchbaseBuilder.KvSslPort`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /pools/default` to port `8091` is completed successfully.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /admin/ping` to port `8093` is completed successfully.
- Startup callback: Configures the Couchbase node.
